text.text: I am currently staying here with my boys.  We have 2 rooms and love it! I have had no issues with extreme smells, and I dated an Indian guy and know what extreme Indian food smells like.  The rooms are a good size and are clean.  Many hotels are opting for cleaning every 3 days or so and when you check out because of the amount of laundry they do and the effect on the environment.  I personally have no problem sleeping in the same sheets for 3 days, and I can straighten my own bed, I'm not an invalid.  They gave me a good amount of towels and linens for my stay and I requested extra pillows at check in which they delivered promptly to my room.  I love that the theme of this hotel seems to be like middle eastern/ Indian.  I can't wait to try out both restaurants. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful.  My boys and I have already decided this will be our go to when we are in Orlando.  I am very happy with my choice, I feel like I found a diamond in the rough when the prices for this hotel are so amazing compared to those around it and I can tell you for sure it's better than many name brands hotels around here.

text.text:
I recently stayed at Cambria during my Universal trip and overall had a really good experience. The hotel feels very newly renovated, modern, and clean. For the price, it’s incredibly convenient and offers great value, especially if you’re visiting the parks and just need a comfortable place to rest. The staff were also consistently friendly and helpful, which made the stay even better.

There were just a couple of minor downsides. The hallway near the elevator on the 4th floor had a very strange and unpleasant smell. It was strong enough to notice each time passing through. I’m pretty sure management is aware of it because the hallway doors were kept closed the following day, likely to contain the odor. Hopefully that’s something they’re already working on resolving.

My biggest disappointment actually wasn’t related to the hotel itself. On the first night, our next-door neighbors were yelling and causing a lot of noise throughout the night until around 5 a.m. When I finally contacted the front desk, they responded immediately and handled the situation quickly and professionally. I honestly wish I had called sooner so I could have gotten more rest, but it was my first time experiencing something like that in a hotel.

That said, I don’t blame the hotel at all for that situation. The staff handled it exactly as they should have. If anything, it might suggest the walls aren’t the thickest, but again, the team responded right away when notified.

Overall, I would absolutely consider staying here again for future Universal trips. I’m not really a resort-style traveler, and this hotel checks all the boxes for a park-focused visit: clean, convenient, reasonably priced, and supported by a great staff.

text.text: We stayed at Cambria for a Volleyball tournament being played at the convention center. Great location, options for food, and shops as well as the theme parks. Beds were VERY comfy and we would stay again for sure. The coffee kiosk in the lobby was clutch for early morning departures for play with Natalia taking care of everyone making delicious drinks. Thank you Natalia!

text.text:
The hotel itself was pleasant, and the beds were super comfortable. My room was very clean, and the shower had good pressure with odor-free water. However, the shower area had no place to put my own products, and the hotel’s toiletries felt watered down.
The air conditioner didn’t work properly. Every time I returned to the room, the temperature had changed on its own, and there was an unpleasant damp smell that made the room feel humid.
Parking was too crowded, but there were nearby parking options available. Still, there was no proper sidewalk or safe pedestrian access to get back to the hotel, which made it inconvenient when carrying luggage unless you parked right in front of the entrance.
The front-desk staff were inconsistent. Some seemed irritated, as if guests were an inconvenience, but one gentleman during my stay was very attentive, and the woman who assisted me at check-out was genuinely kind.
I also found the atmosphere in the common areas uncomfortable, the hotel had a strong curry smell in the halls. For anyone who doesn’t enjoy that scent—or the food—it’s something to keep in mind.
Overall, the location was perfect but not with a quiet environment, the room itself was comfortable, but with all these other issues, I wouldn’t stay here again.

text.text: I should’ve listened to the reviews and not booked with this hotel in the first place. The night prior to our trip my fiance happened to check the reservation to get the address and it says canceled. Neither of us canceled this reservation. When I called the hotel the worker says there was an issue with the card. I never once received a notification that this hotel charged/attempted to charge my card and I receive notifications about everything from my bank. And if the reservation was canceled or it was a “issue with the card” like he claimed why did we never receive a email letting us know. We would’ve drove 6 hours just to be blind sided. The employee was very unapologetic and instead of him offering the room back for the price we had he told me he could not offer that rate and that we could pay the new rate which was more money. When I went on booking.com immediately after the rate was cheaper than we originally booked for. SCAM! I’ll never waste my time here AGAIN! We stayed at the Wyndham garden off of international. Rooms were nice, clean, and modern. That’s where it’s really at!

llm_analysis.investment_thesis: The Cambria Hotel Orlando Universal Blvd presents a moderate distress opportunity driven by operational challenges including guest complaints about smell and noise, and significant renovation needs indicated by both reviews and physical condition scores. Despite no franchise affiliation and a relatively short ownership period, improving sentiment and increasing review activity suggest potential for repositioning through targeted renovations and operational improvements.
llm_analysis.review_summary: Guest feedback highlights recurring issues with unpleasant odors and noise disturbances, alongside notable renovation and maintenance needs. While cleanliness and service do not appear to be major concerns, the property's physical condition is rated poorly. Overall guest sentiment is improving with increasing review activity, indicating positive momentum despite current operational challenges.
